protocol.dataset_name_normalization: lowercase alphanumeric tokens joined by hyphens

claim_scope: Repository-only preblind contamination audit for a later PMLB campaign. This stage may scan Mini-ORIGIN Git history but must not access the PMLB catalogue, repository tree, metadata, dataset names, URLs, records, labels, or bytes. Completion freezes exclusions only and is not solver evidence, external validation, novelty, publication, peer review, or a world-level claim.
